cases.name: validate-project-root
cases.request:
Fix validate runs filing under wrong project root (#624)

* fix validate runs filing under wrong project root

* style: replace em-dash in comment


---------

expect.about: attributionDir is promoted to the git root for the event log and breadcrumb, but runValidationPlan still gets the unpromoted opts.attributionRoot(workDir), so commands register under a root the daemon never tracks when .chunk sits below the git root.

A snapshot (worktree) run passes runRoot as the shadow but req.WorkDir unchanged, and the runner now prefers workDir for --project, so the commands run in the live tree while the result is filed as the snapshot's. Found by the first eval run; still in main at internal/chunkd/server/validate.go.

cases.name: telemetry-error-message
cases.request: Track command success and error type in telemetry

expect.about: The error's message is sent with telemetry; wrapped errors routinely embed absolute file paths, which breaks the no-PII guarantee.

Failure events are never delivered: the sender is only closed in PersistentPostRunE, which cobra skips when RunE returns an error. Found by the first eval run; fixed in #609, which closes the sender after ExecuteC.

cases.name: daemon-socket-path
cases.request:
Report a too-long watch daemon socket path up front (#654)

A Unix socket path is limited to 104 bytes on macOS and 108 on Linux. When
the daemon directory made it longer, the daemon died with 'bind: invalid
argument' in its log and the CLI only said it did not start within 5s.
SocketPath now refuses such a path and names the path, its length, the limit
and the fix (set CHUNK_WATCHD_DIR to a shorter directory).

cases.name: init-hook-symlink
cases.request:
init: skip pre-commit hook when it is a symlink (#616)

When chunk init finds an existing .git/hooks/pre-commit it now calls
os.Lstat (not os.Stat) before any write. If the path is a symlink —
as installed by hook managers like husky, lefthook, or pre-commit —
the function warns and returns without touching the file. Previously
os.WriteFile would silently replace the symlink with a regular file,
breaking the hook manager's setup.
